slides.title: The starfish.
slides.body: Flat out before the timer beeps. A slow walk would clear the legs faster. Still flat.

slides.title: The sweat angel.
slides.body: Leaves a full body outline on the floor. Photographs it. Proud of it.

slides.title: The recount.
slides.body: Swears that was nine rounds. Asks their partner. Their partner says seven.

slides.title: The analyst.
slides.body: Heart rate graph, splits, calories. Shows it to someone who did not ask.

slides.title: The vanishing act.
slides.body: Bag zipped, keys out, gone before the coach says cooldown.

slides.title: The cleaner.
slides.body: Wipes down their gear. Then yours. Then the rower nobody used.
